organization.name: DocWorks AI Labs
organization.shortDesc: Document intelligence agents tuned for Indian KYC, invoices and bilingual paperwork.

agents.label: Executive Brief Summarizer
agents.description: Condenses long-form business reports, board decks and research papers into a 5-bullet executive brief preserving the original argument flow. Tuned for Indian regulatory filings such as SEBI and RBI circulars.

skills.description: Produces a structured executive brief from documents up to 80 pages, calling out risk flags and required actions in a separate section.

agents.label: Bilingual OCR (English + Devanagari)
agents.description: Optical character recognition pipeline trained on Indian utility bills, Aadhaar masking, and Hindi/Marathi government correspondence. Returns layout-aware JSON with page-level bounding boxes.

skills.description: Extracts printed and handwritten text from scanned documents and photos, preserving table structure when the source has rules or grids.

agents.label: Document Entity Extractor
agents.description: Identifies named entities (people, organisations, dates, monetary amounts, GSTIN, PAN, address blocks) inside contracts and invoices. Outputs normalised JSON ready for downstream ERP ingestion.

skills.description: Detects and disambiguates entities across the full document; resolves duplicates and links them to a stable internal id.

agents.label: PDF Table Parser
agents.description: Lifts tabular data out of native and scanned PDFs without relying on column rulers. Handles merged cells, multi-page tables and footnotes; emits CSV plus a JSON schema describing each column.

skills.description: Recovers spreadsheet-like tables from any PDF, inferring headers when missing and reconstructing rows split across pages.

agents.label: PII Redaction Agent
agents.description: Masks personally identifiable information in documents prior to sharing with third parties. Supports Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers, account numbers and free-text addresses; produces a redaction report keyed by page.

skills.description: Replaces sensitive tokens with policy-driven placeholders and emits an audit trail mapping each masked span back to its original position.

agents.label: Invoice Classifier
agents.description: Routes inbound invoices into accounting categories (capex, opex, travel, vendor, intercompany) using a fine-tuned model on Indian GST-formatted invoices. Predicts cost centre and HSN/SAC codes per line item.

skills.description: Assigns a hierarchical accounting label and a confidence score to every line item; flags inconsistencies between header total and line sum.

agents.label: Legal Clause Finder
agents.description: Scans long agreements for clauses such as indemnity, limitation of liability, arbitration seat and termination, returning their verbatim spans plus a one-line plain-language explanation each.

skills.description: Pinpoints predefined clause types within a contract and returns clause-level metadata including start offset, page and confidence.

agents.label: Handwriting Digitizer
agents.description: Specialised OCR for cursive and printed handwriting on forms, prescriptions and field reports. Trained on 1.2 million labelled samples covering both Latin and Devanagari scripts.

skills.description: Converts handwritten content into machine-readable text with per-word confidence; flags illegible regions for human review.

agents.label: Document Deduplicator
agents.description: Detects near-duplicate documents in a corpus using locality-sensitive hashing combined with sentence-level embeddings. Useful when ingesting noisy email attachments where the same PDF arrives via multiple threads.

skills.description: Clusters incoming documents by similarity, returning a canonical id per cluster plus a confidence-scored list of variants.

agents.label: KYC Bundle Validator
agents.description: Verifies a KYC bundle for Indian onboarding flows: confirms Aadhaar masking, checks PAN format and Luhn checksum, validates address proof and produces a single signed evidence pack.

skills.description: Runs document-level and cross-document checks against an onboarding policy; emits a tamper-evident PDF report plus a structured verdict.

organization.name: Polyglot AI Pte Ltd
organization.shortDesc: Multilingual NLP services for cross-border South-East Asian and global commerce.

agents.label: English to Hindi Translator
agents.description: Neural translator specialised for English to Hindi technical and customer-support copy. Preserves transliterated brand names and avoids over-Sanskritising everyday vocabulary.

skills.description: Translates between English and Hindi in both directions with auto-detected source; retains markdown, HTML tags and code snippets unchanged.

agents.label: English to Spanish Translator
agents.description: Bidirectional English-Spanish translation engine with separate dialect heads for Latin American and Iberian Spanish. Suitable for marketing copy, support tickets and product catalogs.

skills.description: Bidirectional translation between English and Spanish with explicit dialect selector (es-419 vs es-ES); preserves placeholders like {name} or %s.

agents.label: English to Japanese Translator
agents.description: English-Japanese translator with politeness-level control (casual, business, keigo) and a glossary slot for product-specific terminology. Handles vertical text rendering hints in the output metadata.

skills.description: Translates English<->Japanese with selectable register; accepts a user glossary that overrides default term choices.

agents.label: English to Arabic Translator
agents.description: English<->Arabic translation with right-to-left layout markers in the response, Modern Standard Arabic as default, and optional dialect heads for Gulf and Egyptian variants on request.

skills.description: Translates English and Arabic in either direction; tags output with directionality hints and offers an optional dialect override.

agents.label: Language Detector
agents.description: Identifies the language and script of arbitrary text snippets, returning ranked candidates with confidence. Robust on short inputs as small as 6 characters thanks to character-level features.

skills.description: Classifies an input string across 97 supported languages and 28 scripts, returning the top-K candidates with calibrated probabilities.

agents.label: Script Transliterator
agents.description: Converts text between writing systems without translating meaning, e.g. Devanagari to Latin or Cyrillic to Latin. Useful for normalising names across registries and search indexes.

skills.description: Phonetic conversion between scripts using ICU rules where available and ML fallbacks for low-resource pairs.

agents.label: Multilingual Sentiment Analyzer
agents.description: Returns sentiment polarity and intensity for short texts across nine languages, with an additional 'sarcasm risk' score that flags ironic reviews where polarity alone misleads.

skills.description: Tags input with a polarity score from -1 to 1 plus discrete labels (positive, negative, neutral, mixed) and a sarcasm-risk flag.

agents.label: Translation Quality Estimator
agents.description: Reference-free quality estimation for machine translation output. Scores adequacy and fluency on the COMET-QE scale and highlights spans likely to contain critical errors.

skills.description: Given a source-target pair, predicts translation quality without a reference and surfaces the lowest-scoring sub-sentences for review.

agents.label: Glossary Aligner
agents.description: Builds bilingual term tables from parallel documents. Aligns multi-word phrases, ranks them by translation entropy and exports TBX or CSV for downstream CAT tools.

skills.description: Discovers and aligns terminology across parallel corpora, emitting a ranked glossary with frequency and confidence.

agents.label: Multilingual Speech Transcriber
agents.description: Audio-to-text transcription that detects the spoken language on the fly and outputs time-coded segments. Tuned for call-center recordings with overlapping speakers.

skills.description: Streaming speech recognition with speaker diarisation and per-segment language tags; outputs SRT or JSON.

organization.name: DevForge AI Inc
organization.shortDesc: AI tooling for software teams: review, security, tests, refactor.

agents.label: Python Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews Python pull requests with a focus on correctness, idiomatic style, type hints and async pitfalls. Returns inline-comment-style suggestions plus a one-paragraph PR summary.

skills.description: Consumes a unified diff plus optional repo context and emits ranked review comments tied to line numbers.

agents.label: Java Code Reviewer
agents.description: Static and semantic review for Java 17+ pull requests. Catches resource leaks, threading issues, equals/hashCode mistakes and Spring anti-patterns; understands Lombok-generated methods.

skills.description: Inspects Java diffs against the surrounding class hierarchy when provided, returning structured findings with severity.

agents.label: TypeScript Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews TypeScript code with tsconfig awareness. Flags unsafe any, missing exhaustive switches over discriminated unions, and React hook violations such as conditional useEffect calls.

skills.description: Reviews TypeScript pull requests; honours strictness flags from the project's tsconfig when provided in the request.

agents.label: Go Code Reviewer
agents.description: Lints Go pull requests with a focus on goroutine leaks, error-wrapping conventions, channel closure ordering and idiomatic interface use. Output is ready for posting to GitHub PR review API.

skills.description: Analyses Go diffs and emits comments suitable for direct posting via the GitHub review API, including suggested replacements.

agents.label: OWASP Top-10 Scanner
agents.description: Scans web application source for OWASP Top-10 risks: injection, broken authentication, SSRF, XSS sinks and insecure deserialization. Cross-references findings with affected request handlers and routes.

skills.description: Performs taint-tracking and pattern detection on a repository snapshot, returning findings ranked by exploitability.

agents.label: Secrets Finder
agents.description: Scans diffs and full repositories for accidentally committed secrets: API tokens, cloud credentials, private keys and JWT payloads. Validates suspicious findings against issuer entropy and known prefixes.

skills.description: Detects secret material in code and history; verifies live credentials when permitted via an opt-in flag.

agents.label: Unit Test Generator
agents.description: Generates unit tests for a target function or class with edge cases, including null inputs, boundary values and exception paths. Supports pytest, JUnit5, Jest and Go testing out of the box.

skills.description: Synthesises test cases targeting branch and boundary coverage; emits ready-to-run files for the chosen test framework.

agents.label: Dependency Auditor
agents.description: Audits manifests (requirements.txt, package.json, pom.xml, go.mod) against CVE databases. Reports actual exposure path of each vulnerability through the import graph, not just version match.

skills.description: Resolves the full dependency tree, intersects with vulnerability feeds, and ranks findings by reachable code paths.

agents.label: API Documentation Generator
agents.description: Generates reference documentation from source comments, type signatures and example tests. Outputs MDX or AsciiDoc with cross-links, and detects missing docstrings to flag for the author.

skills.description: Builds API reference docs from source, optionally enriching summaries from example test fixtures.

agents.label: Refactoring Assistant
agents.description: Suggests safe, behaviour-preserving refactors on a target file: extract method, split god-class, replace if-cascade with polymorphism. Each suggestion ships with an estimated risk score and a test-coverage indicator.

skills.description: Returns a ranked list of refactoring proposals with diff previews, risk and impacted test files.

organization.name: Tela Comunicaciones
organization.shortDesc: Agentes IA para comunicacion empresarial en espanol mexicano y portugues.

agents.label: Business Email Drafter
agents.description: Drafts business emails from short bullet briefs, with tone selection (formal, neutral, friendly) and a regional flag that adapts greetings to Mexican Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese conventions.

skills.description: Produces a complete email (subject + body) from bullet points, respecting tone and region settings.

agents.label: Meeting Summarizer
agents.description: Transforms transcripts into a concise meeting summary plus an action-item table with owners and due dates. Recognises Spanglish utterances and code-switching common in cross-border teams.

skills.description: Generates a structured meeting recap, decisions list and ownership matrix from a raw transcript.

agents.label: Chatbot Script Writer
agents.description: Designs conversational flows for customer support bots with intent branches, fallback paths and tone calibrated to a Mexican retail audience. Exports to Dialogflow or Rasa YAML.

skills.description: Generates a full bot script with intents, entities, branches and sample utterances per intent.

agents.label: Social Media Post Generator
agents.description: Creates short-form posts tailored per platform (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram caption) from a single product brief. Adjusts hashtags and length, and provides three variants per request.

skills.description: Outputs three platform-appropriate variants from a single brief, each with a confidence score and suggested time-to-post.

agents.label: Slack Announcement Writer
agents.description: Composes Slack-flavoured announcements with the right block-kit structure: header, context line, divider, action buttons. Tunes voice to either engineering or general-staff audience as requested.

skills.description: Outputs valid Slack block-kit JSON plus a plain-text fallback variant.

agents.label: Teams Card Composer
agents.description: Builds adaptive cards for Microsoft Teams from a structured prompt, embedding action buttons that map to provided URLs. Tested against the v1.5 adaptive-card schema.

skills.description: Emits validated adaptive-card JSON plus a fallback plain-text rendering.

agents.label: Press Release Writer
agents.description: Drafts AP-style press releases in Spanish or English from a structured fact-sheet. Adds a boilerplate paragraph and ensures the inverted-pyramid structure (lede, supporting quotes, context).

skills.description: Generates a full press release with headline options and an embeddable quote block; ready to copy into Word or send via wire.

agents.label: Communication Tone Coach
agents.description: Rewrites a draft message under a target tone (calm, urgent, empathetic, executive) and highlights phrases that conflict with the desired register. Returns both a rewritten message and a brief coaching note.

skills.description: Rewrites text under the requested tone while preserving the original meaning; produces a side-by-side diff.

agents.label: Multi-Channel Campaign Planner
agents.description: Plans a 7-day omnichannel campaign (email, social, in-app, push) from a single product launch brief. Assigns content variants per channel and proposes a daily send cadence to maximise reach.

skills.description: Outputs a calendar of channel-specific content drafts plus rationale for cadence and audience targeting.

agents.label: NPS Feedback Clusterer
agents.description: Groups free-text NPS or CSAT verbatims into themes and ranks them by frequency and detractor weight. Produces representative quotes per theme to embed in QBR decks.

skills.description: Clusters survey verbatims, surfaces themes with frequency and sentiment weight, and selects exemplar quotes per cluster.

organization.name: Veritas Domain Intelligence
organization.shortDesc: Regulated-domain AI: legal, medical and financial agents for the UK and EEA.

agents.label: Legal Clause Analyzer
agents.description: Reads commercial contracts and produces a per-clause analysis: obligations, restrictions, monetary triggers, governing law and severity. Aligned to UK and EU contract law style guides.

skills.description: Annotates each clause with obligations, parties, monetary triggers and a plain-language summary; cross-references defined terms.

agents.label: Contract Redliner
agents.description: Compares a counterparty draft against a playbook of acceptable positions and produces tracked-change redlines with rationale notes. Supports markup export to .docx.

skills.description: Generates Word-compatible tracked-change redlines and per-edit rationale tied to playbook clauses.

agents.label: Medical Record De-identifier
agents.description: Removes the 18 HIPAA-equivalent identifiers from UK NHS-style medical records, preserving clinical content. Produces a re-identification key under separate access control for legitimate clinical follow-up.

skills.description: Masks personal identifiers across structured and free-text fields, returning a de-identified record and a separate keyset.

agents.label: ICD-10 Coder
agents.description: Assigns ICD-10 diagnostic codes to clinical narratives and discharge summaries. Returns multiple plausible codes per claim with rationale snippets quoted from the input.

skills.description: Suggests ICD-10 codes with evidence spans and confidence; flags codes that require manual coder review.

agents.label: Financial Report Summarizer
agents.description: Summarises annual and quarterly reports filed under UK GAAP and IFRS. Extracts KPIs, year-over-year deltas and management commentary into a structured fact-pack suitable for analyst briefings.

skills.description: Produces a KPI snapshot, YoY comparison and a 3-paragraph narrative summary citing report page numbers.

agents.label: Fraud Pattern Detector
agents.description: Inspects transaction streams for structuring, mule activity and unusual merchant cross-references. Output includes a per-transaction risk score, a contributing-feature list and a triage recommendation.

skills.description: Scores incoming transactions in near real time, returning risk band, top contributing features and a triage suggestion.

agents.label: Regulatory Compliance Checker
agents.description: Validates a document against a configurable rule-pack covering GDPR, MiFID II and FCA conduct rules. Generates a compliance dossier with passing, failing and indeterminate findings, each with citations.

skills.description: Runs configurable regulatory rule-packs over a document and emits a structured dossier with passes, failures and citations.

agents.label: Case Law Finder
agents.description: Given a legal question or factual matrix, returns the most relevant English and Welsh case law along with neutral citations and one-sentence ratio descriptions. Indexed against bailii and curated UKSC reports.

skills.description: Ranks candidate cases by relevance and returns neutral citations, jurisdiction, year and a ratio summary.

agents.label: Patient Triage Assistant
agents.description: Reads patient-reported symptoms and recommends a triage band (self-care, GP within 24h, urgent care, A&E) aligned to NHS 111 logic. Never returns a diagnosis; always cites the rule path used.

skills.description: Maps symptom narrative to a triage band with the rule path used, always recommending professional follow-up.

agents.label: AML Screening Agent
agents.description: Screens counterparties against sanctions lists, PEP databases and adverse-media corpora. Produces a single risk verdict with hit details and a recommended escalation step for the MLRO.

skills.description: Looks up names and entities across multiple regulatory feeds and returns consolidated hits with confidence and recency.
